summary: Identified 6 Charlotte multifamily refinance opportunities with active, confirmed loans and executed-note maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31, no executed extensions, and current Director of Finance contacts verified since 2026-03-01. Records were ranked by confirmed maturity date, then original principal. Duplicates were consolidated (R1514 duplicate of R6774). A prospect CSV was generated with citations and the selected facts: artifacts/prospects-v7.csv.
limitations: Outstanding balances were not provided in the evidence and are reported as null.
Only evidence published/effective on or before 2026-08-31 was considered; later updates (e.g., recorded releases) were not applied.
Contact roles depend on the provided team-page confirmations; no independent verification beyond supplied sources.
Owner verification dates prior to 2026-03-01 were treated as stale per scope and excluded.
